scenes.headline: How a 5B model streams a world you can steer
scenes.sub: ABot-World-0: hold WASD, and a 720p world answers at up to 16 fps.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Marzipan! Upload one image, hold WASD, and ABot-World-0 streams a world you can walk through, from one desktop GPU. Here's how it's trained.

scenes.text: Distill a bidirectional teacher that sees whole clips into a causal student that streams, then train it against its own long rollouts.
scenes.say: The idea: distill a teacher that sees whole clips into a student that streams. Then train that student on its own long rollouts.

items.text: A bidirectional teacher learns the dynamics
items.say: First, an action-conditioned teacher learns the dynamics. It's accurate, but it needs the whole clip at once, so it can't stream.

items.text: Distill it into a causal student
items.say: Second, distillation compresses it into a few-step causal student that works turn by turn.

items.text: LongForcing corrects the student's own rollouts
items.say: Third, LongForcing. The student makes a long rollout of its own, and that rollout's distribution is corrected against a longer-horizon teacher.

steps.say: Start from one image. Each keypress becomes action tokens, added to the student's conditioning.
The student generates the next chunk of frames in a few steps, about one point two seconds after you act.

steps.note: Plain causal forcing drifts after 20 to 30 seconds
steps.say: Those frames become its context for the next chunk, so errors compound. Without LongForcing, a rollout blurs and repeats patches after about twenty seconds.

scenes.title: Real time is five fixes, in order

left.title: Faster attention first
items: The model still doesn't fit in memory
You get a faster out-of-memory error
left.say: A faster attention kernel alone does nothing. The model doesn't fit in memory to begin with.

right.title: Swap the VAE first
items: Now the model fits on one GPU
Then every later speedup can be measured
right.say: Swap the VAE and it fits. Only then do the other speedups count. All five changes are load-bearing.

scenes.title: WorldRoamBench strict accuracy
scenes.note: third-party benchmark; HappyOyster leads on 6 of 7 metrics
scenes.say: On the third-party WorldRoamBench it beats both larger open rivals, but places second. HappyOyster leads on six of seven metrics.

scenes.text: The speed comes from training against its own drift, and from a systems stack where every fix counts.
scenes.say: So the speed comes from training against its own drift, and from a systems stack where every fix counts.

recap: Bidirectional teacher, causal student, then LongForcing
Its own long rollouts, corrected against drift
Five systems fixes for one desktop GPU
scenes.say: To recap: a teacher distilled into a streaming student, trained against its own drift, on one desktop GPU.
